sections.heading: Before a task fades
sections.body: Tasks slowly fade from your mind if left alone. Tap a card to say "I remember" and reset the countdown.

sections.heading: Completing a task
sections.body: Swipe a task right to finish it. Choosing "Yes" plays a little celebration and records it as done.

sections.heading: Editing
sections.body: Tap the pencil icon on the right of a card to open a menu for completing or deleting it.

sections.heading: Reordering
sections.body: Long-press a card, then drag up or down to put tasks in whatever order you like.

sections.heading: If a task disappears
sections.body: A dedicated screen appears when a task fully fades. Watch an ad to bring it back, or choose "Let it go" to record it in your history.

sections.heading: Premium
sections.body: Premium removes ads and unlocks extra design themes.
